title: Comparing Classification and Feature Learning by Analyzing Their Loss Functions in Normalized Spaces with Different Scale Factors
summary: The paper analyzes how cross-entropy and binary cross-entropy losses affect classification and feature geometry in normalized spaces, then tests the analysis with neural-network experiments. Under the tested training setup, scale factors changed classification accuracy and feature quality differently; the conclusions are tied to the reported losses and experiments.
